---
description: Analyze UI references and propose a coherent design system for the product.
---
Read the UX/UI skill and UI reference workflow. Inspect every attached image separately; record palette, typography, layout, components, imagery, interaction hypotheses, responsive risks and accessibility. Compare styles only after each image has its own analysis. Recommend one product-specific direction and define tokens, page hierarchy, reusable components and responsive states. Mark estimates and uncertainties. Ask before major redesign unless implementation was explicitly requested.
